newsitem.title: USA: CME live and feeder cattle seen steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: CME live and feeder cattle seen steady to lower.

text.p: CME live cattle and feeder cattle futures were both expected to open steady to 0.200 cent lower, analysts said.

Most analysts look for further pressure in live cattle futures following the easier tone to cash markets and weak technicals. Feedlots sold cattle at $71 per cwt and boxed beef values declined $0.76 to $0.23 per cwt which should put further pressure on futures, analysts said.
However, some analysts consider the market oversold after late fund selling Wednesday. Also, fed cattle supplies will remain tight for the next couple of weeks, they added.
Feeder futures were expected to follow the lead of live cattle futures with a lower feeder index and expectations of steady to firmer corn futures also cited as selling factors, analysts said.
The latest CME feeder cattle index was off $0.17 at $63.17 per cwt, the lowest price level since September 4.
